body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 3d75878691bd5617778c769d8c695791473a485a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good

- One command table (`panes/table.rs`) now feeds the ribbon's anchor groups, the menu bar and the keyboard layer: the hand-typed FILE/SETUP/MODIFY/INSPECT/VIEW constants in `cmd.rs` are gone, the anchor groups are `table::ribbon_group` lookups, `label_of` and the tips read the table, and the new menu-only rows (Copy, Paste, Quit, Toggle projection) each say what they are. A `Cmd` never has two labels anymore.
- The keyboard layer is a table-driven fire loop instead of an if-chain. I compared every row's key/modifier/typing logic against the old chain one by one: the history keys fire while typing, the Copy/Paste/New/Project keys and the Delete/Frame/projection keys fire only while no text field owns focus, Ctrl+Z keeps the no-shift/no-alt guard, bare P stays separate from Ctrl+P (Post), and Shift+O/Shift+S/Shift+Y keep their shift rules. The menu bar's rows run the same `run_direct` path as the keys (Model and Open go straight to their file dialogs), and the disabled rows give the reason on hover while the Create rows keep their refusal tips.
- The tests pin the new behaviour: eight new pinning tests in `command_table.rs` (ribbon/menu id parity per machine mode and pins, label/tip/enabled per row, no two shortcuts sharing, disabled-reason, the quit/projection/paste flows and the named layout test `layout_window_menu_bar`), all green. The shell tests that measure the window top read `menu_bar_h` now, and the whole bar height is in whole points (last commit).
- Clean, not just tidy: the `#[cfg(test)]`-gated table helpers keep the release build honest, the decision file is present with the expected format, no snapshot PNGs, no process files, no dependencies, no new top-level test binary, `crates/ui` `#[test]` count 2019 -> 2027 (+8, exactly the new tests).

Results merged with main (trial merge clean - `origin/main` `2394b5ad1` is an ancestor of the head)

- Local in the worktree of the head (not the runner; the dispatcher directed a local targeted build): `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-run` builds clean.
- `ui lib`: 1824 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored (all the `command_table` tests included).
- The 8 quick-gate integration suites: boundary (3), boundary_picks (7), contour_dxf_sketch (2), sinker_setup (2), tap_hand (3), theme_example (3), theme_files (34), waterjet_tool (1) - all green.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo check -p camcraft-ui --release`: clean (the test-only-helpers fix verified in release).
- `git diff origin/main...pr-4490-review` touches 16 files; no `build.rs`, `.github/`, `scripts/`, `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`, toolchain, `.cargo/` or `xtask/` file.

Targeted tests (step 5)

- Example catalog suites: not applicable - no post or toolpath change; the diff is `crates/ui` plus the decision file.
- Light lane: not run - the review was dispatched with no heavy lanes at review (#3556), this is a `P6` ui-only change with no heavy-lane reach, and the light plan maps only release twins of motion/app heavy tests (11 twins) that this diff cannot have broken. It is not "owed" here; if the maintainer wants the light run, the full command is `cargo xtask gate light --base origin/main`.
- No heavy step: not a `P1` (no safety-floor surface); none owed.

Requested before merge

None.

Questions / notes (non-blocking)

- `layout_window_menu_bar` lives in `command_table.rs` rather than `tests/page_layout.rs`, where the refit/layout rule (#1953, UI AGENTS.md "A UI refit PR keeps its tests") points the named `layout_window_*` test. The test is the same shape as its siblings and passes; moving it would be a separate tidy PR, not a blocker.
- Known small gaps the author flagged (I agree they are review-tolerable): (a) the keys (Del, Ctrl+S, ...) still fire while a menu popup is open - the typing guard is unchanged and a popup does not count as typing; same class as the ribbon dropdowns before this PR, so not a new defect; (b) Quit now has a menu row and is enabled in the browser build (a window has no close in a browser); Ctrl+Q had the same behaviour. Worth a follow-up issue if the browser build should not offer Quit.
- `shell.rs` is 1216 lines (pre-existing, +5 here). The 400-line law is the nudge that keeps new UI changes out of that file; a note, not a blocker.
- Stale-link check: the four screenshot links in the PR body, the issue links (#4484, #4245, #4398, #3025, #4491, #1953, #107) and the decision file paths (`panes/table.rs`, `panes/cmd.rs`, `panes/gates.rs`, `panes/run.rs`) all resolve at the head. The `ribbon.rs` references in the tips comments pre-date this PR and were left alone; a separate tidy could clean them.
- Decision file lacks an explicit "why" paragraph (the README's format asks for what was decided, why, what was dropped and the cost to change later) - one line would close that.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
